name: identity_music_beds_list
title: List identity music beds
description: App-only Brand/Music Studio library read. Returns a terse index of account-owned music beds (plus global samples): title, generation prompt, provider, duration, kind, and readiness — enough to choose a bed by its described vibe without listening. Deep metadata/provenance stays on single-bed payloads. To browse beds alongside openers, outros, and project defaults use identity_assets_list. To make a song the default full-Episode cue on future reels use identity_apply_to_project; to score an existing Episode use music_cue_mutate. Omit project_id for the account-level library (Music Studio).

project_id.description: Project public ID. Omit for the account library.
